annotations.title: Audit tags against a controlled vocabulary

description: Audit a library against a controlled tag vocabulary with priority tiers. Provide the vocabulary inline as `vocabulary` (or a JSON file via `vocabulary_path`): { tags:[{name,tier?}], tiers?:[{name,required?}] }. Reports (1) off-taxonomy tags (library tags not in the vocabulary; Zotero auto-applied tags are bucketed separately unless include_auto), (2) items missing a tag from each required tier, and (3) optional per-collection coverage when `scope.collection_keys` is given. A key that none of these objects knows is refused and named, never dropped: a dropped `scope`, `tier` or `required` would change the question without changing the answer. Read-only. Tag and item enumeration both follow the library route, so a running Zotero desktop app serves the whole audit with no cloud API key.

include_auto.description: Treat Zotero auto-applied tags as off-taxonomy too.

library_id.description: Numeric id of the library to address, e.g. 5234875 for a group (zotero_groups lists the ids you can reach). Omit to use the configured default library; an id given without library_type is read as a group id.

library_type.description: Which library to address: "user" (a personal library) or "group" (a shared group library). Omit to use the library this server is configured for. "group" on its own is refused: pass library_id with it.

scope.description: Per-collection coverage: `{ collection_keys: [...] }`. A key this tool does not know is refused, never ignored.

collection_keys.description: 8-character collection keys to report coverage for, one report per key, e.g. ["ABCD1234"].

vocabulary.description: The controlled vocabulary, inline: { tags: [{name, tier?}], tiers?: [{name, required?}] }. Use `vocabulary_path` instead to read it from a JSON file; passing both is refused.

tags.description: The tags the library is allowed to use; anything else is reported as off-taxonomy.

name.description: The tag exactly as it is spelled in Zotero (case-sensitive), e.g. "method/bayesian".

tier.description: Name of the tier this tag belongs to, matching a `vocabulary.tiers` entry, e.g. "topic".

tiers.description: Tier definitions referenced by the tags, e.g. [{"name":"topic","required":true}].

name.description: Tier name, referenced by a tag's `tier`, e.g. "topic" or "status".

required.description: Whether every item must carry a tag from this tier (default false). Items that do not are reported per tier.

vocabulary_path.description: Path to a JSON file with the vocabulary.

name: zotero_tag_audit

autoTags.description: Zotero auto-applied tags, bucketed apart unless include_auto was set.

autoTagsTotal.description: How many of those there are in total.

collections.description: Per-collection coverage; present only when scope.collection_keys was given.

collectionKey.description: The collection this report is for.

missingByTier.description: The same per-tier gaps, inside that collection.

itemsScanned.description: Top-level items audited (notes and attachments are skipped).

missingByTier.description: Per required tier, the items carrying no tag from it.

itemCount.description: Items carrying no tag from this tier.

omitted.description: How many more there are beyond `limit`.

offTaxonomy.description: Library tags the vocabulary does not list, capped at `limit`.

name.description: The tag as the library spells it.

offTaxonomyTotal.description: How many there are in total.
